# Terraform Developer Portal template and add-on variables

Terraform Developer Portal provides variables that you can reference in the developer instructions for templates and add-ons. The portal replaces each variable with its value, such as the application or add-on name. To write developer instructions, refer to [Create and manage templates](/terraform/cloud-docs/developer-portal/template-create) and [Create and manage add-on definitions](/terraform/cloud-docs/developer-portal/addon-create).

@include "beta/tdp.mdx"

Use the `{{VARIABLE}}` syntax to reference these variables.

## Template variables

Terraform Developer Portal makes the following variables available to you when you create a template. 

| Name | Value | 
| ---- | ----- |
| `.ApplicationName` | The name of the deployed application. |
| `.TfcOrgName` | The name of the HCP Terraform organization the template belongs to. |

Example:

<CodeBlockConfig hideClipboard>

```text
This {{.ApplicationName}} is deployed to the {{.TfcOrgName}} HCP Terraform organization.
```

</CodeBlockConfig>

## Add-on variables

Terraform Developer Portal makes the following variables available to you when you create an add-on.

| Name | Value | 
| ---- | ----- |
| `.ApplicationName` | The name of the deployed application. |
| `.AddonName` | The name of the deployed add-on. |

Example:

<CodeBlockConfig hideClipboard>

```text
The {{.AddOnName}} add-on belongs to the {{.ApplicationName}} application.
```

</CodeBlockConfig>
